newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end up, more climbs seen next week.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end up, more climbs seen next week.

text.p: 1419 GMT - South African stocks end up after a day of heavy trade, but gains capped by end of week profit-taking. Gold shares make healthy advances on back of better bullion price. More than 1.36 billion rands worth of shares change hands and stocks seen posting further gains next week.

* The industrials index climbs to another new record high of 9,054.4, up 28.1 points, as the all-share index gains 17.0 points to 7,444.0. The golds index puts on 17.2 points, or 1.8 percent, to 969.8.
* Shares in electronics to healthcare firm Jasco Electronics soars in heavy volume on speculative buying that a deal was imminent. Jasco adds 54 cents to 280 cents.

* East Rand Proprietary Mines Ltd sinks to a year-low of 70 cents in active early trade after the gold producer warned late on Thursday there was a strong possibility that it could close. But stocks recovers to end one cent up at 101 cents.
* JCI Ltd gains 100 cents to 31.25 rand after news it has sold its shares in Johnson Matthey to possibly help funds its buy of a Lonrho stake.
